title: Cheating by personation
text: Cheating by pretending to be another person, substituting one for another, or representing someone else. Includes impersonating law enforcement, CBI, ED, or customs.

title: Cheating & dishonestly inducing delivery
text: Cheating and thereby dishonestly inducing the person deceived to deliver any property, money, or valuable security to any person.

title: Invalidity of Digital Arrests
text: There is no provision in Indian criminal law allowing 'Digital Arrest'. Agencies cannot legally detain or demand bail via Skype, WhatsApp, or video calls.

title: Organised crime
text: Any continuing unlawful activity including kidnapping, robbery, vehicle theft, extortion, land grabbing, contract killing, economic offences, cyber-crimes by a syndicate.

title: Petty organised crime
text: Committing theft, snatching, cheating, unauthorized ticket sales, betting, or public examination leaks as a member of a group or gang.

title: Extortion
text: Intentionally putting any person in fear of injury to them or another, and dishonestly inducing them to deliver property or valuable security.

title: Forgery
text: Making a false document or false electronic record with intent to cause damage or injury, to support any claim, or cause any person to part with property.

title: Forgery of valuable security
text: Forgery of a document purporting to be a valuable security, a will, or an authority to adopt a son, or transfer valuable securities.

title: Using a forged document as genuine
text: Fraudulently or dishonestly using as genuine any document or electronic record which the person knows or has reason to believe is forged.

title: Criminal breach of trust
text: Dishonest misappropriation or conversion to one's own use of property entrusted to them, or disposing of it in violation of legal direction.

title: Theft
text: Intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without their consent.

title: Snatching
text: Theft becomes snatching if, to commit theft, the offender suddenly, quickly, or forcibly seizes or secures movable property from a person.

title: Robbery
text: In all robbery there is either theft or extortion. Involves voluntarily causing or attempting to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint.

title: Dacoity
text: When five or more persons conjointly commit or attempt to commit a robbery.

title: Dishonest misappropriation of property
text: Dishonestly misappropriating or converting to one's own use any movable property, including finding lost property and keeping it.

title: Terrorist act
text: Acts with intent to threaten unity, integrity, sovereignty, or economic security of India, using bombs, explosives, or hazardous substances.

title: Waging war against the Government
text: Waging, attempting to wage, or abetting the waging of war against the Government of India.

title: Sedition / Acts endangering sovereignty
text: Exciting disaffection, secession, armed rebellion, or subversive activities through words, signs, electronic communication, or financial means.

title: Criminal Intimidation
text: Threatening another with injury to person, reputation, or property to cause alarm or force them to do something they are not legally bound to do.

title: Defamation
text: Making or publishing imputations to harm the reputation of a person through words, signs, or visible representations.

title: Intentional insult to provoke breach of peace
text: Intentionally insulting someone, knowing it is likely to provoke them to break the public peace or commit an offence.

title: Public mischief
text: Making, publishing, or circulating false statements or rumors with intent to cause mutiny, public alarm, or incite offences against the State.

title: Deceitful sexual intercourse
text: Employing deceitful means (false promise of employment/promotion/marriage, or concealing identity) to induce sexual intercourse.

title: Assault to outrage modesty
text: Assaulting or using criminal force against any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty.

title: Sexual harassment
text: Physical contact and advances involving unwelcome sexual overtures, demanding sexual favors, showing pornography, or making sexually colored remarks.

title: Voyeurism
text: Watching or capturing the image of a woman engaging in a private act in circumstances where she expects privacy.

title: Stalking
text: Following a woman, contacting her repeatedly despite disinterest, or monitoring her use of the internet, email, or any electronic communication.

title: Insulting modesty of a woman
text: Uttering any word, making any sound or gesture, or exhibiting any object intending that it be heard or seen by a woman to insult her modesty.

title: Kidnapping
text: Conveying a person beyond limits of India or kidnapping a minor or person of unsound mind from lawful guardianship.

title: Abduction
text: By force compelling, or by any deceitful means inducing, any person to go from any place.

title: Kidnapping or abducting for ransom
text: Kidnapping or abducting and threatening to cause death or hurt, to compel the Government, foreign State, or person to pay a ransom.

title: Criminal conspiracy
text: When two or more persons agree to do, or cause to be done, an illegal act, or a legal act by illegal means.

title: Abetment
text: Instigating any person to do an offence, engaging in conspiracy to do an offence, or intentionally aiding the doing of an offence.

title: Murder
text: Doing an act with the intention of causing death, or causing such bodily injury as is known to be likely to cause death.

title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
text: Causing death by doing an act with the intention of causing death, but under grave and sudden provocation or exceeding the right of private defense.

title: Abetment of suicide
text: Instigating, intentionally aiding, or engaging in a conspiracy to cause a person to commit suicide.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt
text: Doing any act with the intention of thereby causing hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt.

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
text: Voluntarily causing hurt which endangers life, causes severe bodily pain for twenty days, or permanently impairs limbs/joints.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt to extort property
text: Causing hurt to extort property, valuable security, or compel a person to do anything illegal.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt to extort confession
text: Causing hurt to extort from the sufferer any confession or any information which may lead to the detection of an offence or misconduct.

title: Acid attack
text: Voluntarily causing permanent or partial damage or deformity by throwing acid or administering acid to that person.

title: Wrongful restraint
text: Voluntarily obstructing any person so as to prevent that person from proceeding in any direction in which they have a right to proceed.

title: Wrongful confinement
text: Wrongfully restraining a person in such a manner as to prevent them from proceeding beyond certain circumscribing limits.

title: Unlawful assembly
text: An assembly of five or more persons intending to overawe the Government by criminal force, or to commit any mischief or criminal trespass.

title: Rioting
text: When force or violence is used by an unlawful assembly, or by any member thereof, in prosecution of the common object.

title: Affray
text: When two or more persons, by fighting in a public place, disturb the public peace.

title: Promoting enmity between different groups
text: Promoting enmity on grounds of religion, race, place of birth, residence, language, etc., and doing acts prejudicial to maintenance of harmony.

title: Imputations prejudicial to national integration
text: Making or publishing any assertion or plea that a class of persons cannot bear true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of India.

title: Attempt to commit suicide to compel action
text: Doing an act to commit suicide with intent to compel or restrain any public servant from discharging their official duty.

title: Personating a public servant
text: Pretending to hold any particular office as a public servant, knowing that one does not hold such office, to act under color of such office.

title: Wearing garb of public servant
text: Wearing any garb or carrying any token resembling that used by a public servant with the intent to be believed as belonging to that class.

title: Giving false evidence
text: Being legally bound by an oath to state the truth, making a statement which is false, and which one knows or believes to be false.

title: Fabricating false evidence
text: Causing any circumstance to exist or making any false entry in a book or electronic record, intending it to appear in evidence in a proceeding.

title: Causing disappearance of evidence
text: Causing any evidence of the commission of an offence to disappear, or giving false information, with the intention of screening the offender.

title: Harbouring an offender
text: Harbouring or concealing a person whom one knows or has reason to believe to be the offender, with the intention of screening them from punishment.

title: Public nuisance
text: Doing an act or being guilty of an illegal omission which causes common injury, danger, or annoyance to the public.

title: Adulteration of food or drink
text: Adulterating any article of food or drink so as to make it noxious, intending to sell it as food or drink.

title: Adulteration of drugs
text: Adulterating any drug or medical preparation to lessen its efficacy, change its operation, or make it noxious.

title: Rash driving
text: Driving any vehicle or riding on any public way in a manner so rash or negligent as to endanger human life.

title: Obscene acts and songs
text: Doing any obscene act in a public place, or singing, reciting or uttering obscene songs, ballads or words in or near any public place.

title: Sale of obscene books
text: Selling, distributing, publicly exhibiting, or putting into circulation any obscene book, pamphlet, paper, drawing, painting, representation, or figure.

title: Injuring or defiling a place of worship
text: Destroying, damaging or defiling any place of worship, or any object held sacred by any class of persons.

title: Deliberate acts to outrage religious feelings
text: Uttering words or making representations with deliberate and malicious intention of outraging the religious feelings of any class of citizens.

title: Disturbing religious assembly
text: Voluntarily causing disturbance to any assembly lawfully engaged in the performance of religious worship or religious ceremonies.

title: Criminal misappropriation
text: Dishonestly misappropriating or converting to one's own use any movable property.

title: Stolen property
text: Property the possession of which has been transferred by theft, extortion, or robbery, or which has been criminally misappropriated.

title: Mischief
text: With intent to cause wrongful loss or damage to the public or any person, causing destruction of property or changing its situation.

title: Mischief by fire or explosive
text: Committing mischief by fire or any explosive substance intending to cause damage to property or agricultural produce.

title: Criminal trespass
text: Entering into or upon property in the possession of another with intent to commit an offence or to intimidate, insult or annoy any person.

title: House-trespass
text: Committing criminal trespass by entering into or remaining in any building, tent, or vessel used as a human dwelling or for custody of property.

title: Lurking house-trespass
text: Committing house-trespass having taken precautions to conceal such house-trespass from someone who has a right to exclude or eject them.

title: House-breaking
text: Committing house-trespass through a passage made by oneself, scaling a wall, opening a lock, or using criminal force.

title: House-breaking by night
text: Committing house-breaking after sunset and before sunrise.

title: Falsification of accounts
text: Being a clerk, officer, or servant, willfully and with intent to defraud, destroying, altering, mutilating, or falsifying any book, paper, or electronic record.

title: Counterfeiting currency-notes
text: Counterfeiting, or knowingly performing any part of the process of counterfeiting, any currency-note or bank-note.

title: Using forged currency-notes
text: Selling to, buying from, or receiving from any person, or otherwise trafficking in or using as genuine, forged currency-notes.

title: Possession of forged currency
text: Having in possession any forged or counterfeit currency-note or bank-note, knowing or having reason to believe it is forged.

title: Word or gesture to outrage modesty
text: Uttering any word, making any sound or gesture, or exhibiting any object intending to insult the modesty of a woman.

title: Punishment for criminal conspiracy
text: Punishment for parties to a criminal conspiracy to commit an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment.

title: General Exceptions: Act of judge
text: Nothing is an offence which is done by a Judge when acting judicially in the exercise of any power which is given to them by law.

title: General Exceptions: Accident
text: Nothing is an offence which is done by accident or misfortune, without any criminal intention or knowledge, in doing a lawful act in a lawful manner.

title: General Exceptions: Necessity
text: Nothing is an offence merely by reason of its being done with the knowledge that it is likely to cause harm, if done without criminal intent to prevent greater harm.

title: General Exceptions: Child under 7
text: Nothing is an offence which is done by a child under seven years of age.

title: General Exceptions: Insanity
text: Nothing is an offence which is done by a person who, at the time of doing it, by reason of unsoundness of mind, is incapable of knowing the nature of the act.

title: General Exceptions: Intoxication
text: Nothing is an offence which is done by a person who is incapable of knowing the nature of the act due to intoxication, provided the thing was administered without their knowledge.

title: Right of private defence of body
text: Every person has a right to defend their own body, and the body of any other person, against any offence affecting the human body.

title: Right of private defence of property
text: Every person has a right to defend the property of themselves or any other person against theft, robbery, mischief or criminal trespass.

title: When private defence extends to causing death (Body)
text: The right of private defence of the body extends to voluntarily causing death or any other harm if the assault causes reasonable apprehension of death, grievous hurt, rape, or kidnapping.

title: When private defence extends to causing death (Property)
text: The right of private defence of property extends to causing death in cases of robbery, house-breaking by night, mischief by fire, or theft causing apprehension of death or hurt.

title: Commutation of sentence of death
text: The appropriate Government may, without the consent of the offender, commute the punishment for an offence punishable with death to any other punishment.

title: Public servant disobeying direction of law
text: Being a public servant, knowingly disobeying any direction of the law with intent to save any person from punishment or property from forfeiture.

title: Public servant framing incorrect record
text: Being a public servant charged with the preparation of any record, framing it incorrectly to save a person from punishment.

title: Omission to apprehend by public servant
text: Being a public servant legally bound to apprehend a person charged with an offence, intentionally omitting to apprehend them.

title: Escape from confinement
text: Intentionally offering resistance or illegal obstruction to the lawful apprehension of oneself for any offence.

title: Insult to public servant sitting in judicial proceeding
text: Intentionally offering insult or causing interruption to any public servant sitting in any stage of a judicial proceeding.

title: Counterfeiting coin
text: Counterfeiting or knowingly performing any part of the process of counterfeiting any coin.

title: Counterfeiting Indian coin
text: Counterfeiting or knowingly performing any part of the process of counterfeiting Indian coin.

title: Using false weight or measure
text: Fraudulently using any false weight or false measure of length or capacity, or using any weight or measure as a different weight or measure.

title: Being in possession of false weight
text: Being in possession of any instrument for weighing, or of any weight, or measure, knowing the same to be false.

title: Making or selling false weight
text: Making, selling, or disposing of any instrument for weighing, or any weight, or measure, knowing the same to be false.

title: Offences affecting public health
text: Negligent or malignant acts likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life.

title: Making atmosphere noxious to health
text: Voluntarily vitiating the atmosphere in any place to make it noxious to the health of persons in general dwelling or carrying on business in the neighborhood.

title: Negligent conduct with fire
text: Doing any act with fire or any combustible matter so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life.

title: Negligent conduct with explosive substance
text: Doing any act with any explosive substance so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life.

title: Making or possessing counterfeit seal
text: Making or counterfeiting any seal, plate, or instrument for making an impression, intending it to be used for committing forgery.
